about: Short tips shown the first time each place in the menu opens (and from its ? button). scene: the drawing above the text (hubs, tabs, controller, difficulty, freeplay, routine, daily, ghost, board, packs, record, net, share, friends, progress, settings).

steps.title: Everything in a few places
steps.text: Train to practise, Compete for the Daily, races and the Shot Board, and Create for your own drills. Friends, Progress and Settings are yours.

steps.title: Tabs along the top
steps.text: Each place keeps its pages as tabs along the top. The ? button in the corner brings these tips back any time.

steps.title: In a drill
steps.text: R3 resets the shot, D-pad right and left go to the next or previous one, and D-pad down is slow motion. You can change them in Settings.

steps.title: Pick a drill
steps.text: Exercises has every drill. Pick Easy, Medium or Hard and press Play; star the ones you like to find them fast.

steps.title: Freeplay+
steps.text: Free play with goals popping up around the field: rings, targets and shots, while you play however you like.

steps.title: Your routine
steps.text: Build a warm-up you can play in order every day. Sessions & Labs has timed playlists made for you.

steps.title: The Daily Challenge
steps.text: The same ten shots for every player today. One attempt counts, and once it's done your score is locked in for the day.

steps.title: Races and ghosts
steps.text: Beat your best and that run becomes your ghost. Open a race's Board to race a friend's ghost instead.

steps.title: The Shot Board
steps.text: Shots players posted. Play one, like it, or add it to your own drills.

steps.title: Any training pack, your way
steps.text: Paste the code of ANY training pack on the Training Packs tab and every shot becomes a Free Touch drill. Then put a bot in net to defend it, and pick the part of the net you have to score in: chosen tiles, a random one, a moving one, or a hole just bigger than the ball.

steps.title: Record your own drill
steps.text: Press record, play the moment out, then drag the timeline to where your drill should start and save it.

steps.title: Set it up when you play
steps.text: Your recorded drills work the same way: Play asks for a defender and a net target, from picked tiles to a hole just bigger than the ball.

steps.title: Share it
steps.text: Copy it as a file for Discord, send it straight to a friend, or post it on the Shot Board.

steps.title: Add friends by code
steps.text: Give your friend code, or type theirs. They accept, and you see each other's training: minutes, streak and last drill.

steps.title: Play together
steps.text: Send each other shots, and see each other on the Daily and race leaderboards.

steps.title: Watch yourself improve
steps.text: Your training time, records and rank over time, and a journal of each day's routine and notes.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.text: Your account, controls, sounds and colours. Pick a name under Account to play with friends.
